mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tag_binding (user_id, tag_id, source, pk_id, gmt_create, gmt_modified) VALUES (#{userId}, #{tagId}, #{source}, #{pkId}, #{gmtCreate}, #{gmtModified})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM tag_binding WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND tag_id = #{tagId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM tag_binding WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND tag_id = #{tagId}
